notes:
- Users and permissions: the owner adds users with their own passwords and chooses, page by page and form by form, what each of them may view, add and edit; templates for view only, data entry and full access
- Every record shows who created and who last changed it
- Setup is done only on an encrypted disk (BitLocker on Windows, encrypted APFS on macOS, LUKS on Linux); existing data on an unencrypted disk shows a warning
- Restore from backup on the start screen: a backup taken on this computer and USB disk can be restored after the database or key file was lost
- Program name and logo: 10 logos to choose from; on Windows the program files take the program name too
- Sample data is created in the language you chose; amounts kept small
- New entries from an account card keep that account selected
- Fixed: the monthly collection rate and the performance card showed impossible values with the sample data
- Fixed: an error during setup from a transfer package was not shown
- "Digital POS" is no longer a built-in payment type; where it is already in use it stays
